title: 生化学
subtitle: Biochemistry
keywords: Enzymes and coenzymes 2.Enzymatic reaction 3.Biochemistry of glycans 4.Biochemistry of lipids 5.Biochemistry of amino acids
educationalGoal: Students will learn: (1) structures, classifications, and properties of biomaterials, such as glycans, lipids, and amino acids. (2) biosynthesis and metabolism of the biomaterials. (3) enzymatic reactions based on stereochemistry,
advice: Biochemistry of glycans, lipids, and amino acids is very important to the pharmaceutial, food, and chemical industries. In this course, reactions and the mechanisms of enzymes and coenzymes will be presented first. Then, structures, classifications, properties, metabolism, and biosyntheses of glycans, lipids, amino acids and proteins, and nucleotides will be studied. Students will aquire the basic knowledge necessary to apply the use of biochemistry in future professional work.
